blocks.html: We remove your failed engine and fit a replacement unit — whether used, rebuilt, or remanufactured — with full inspection, preparation, and road-testing before handover.

Engine replacement is often the fastest route to getting a BMW back on the road when the original engine has suffered major internal damage, or when a rebuild isn't economically viable. We source a compatible replacement, prepare it thoroughly, and install it to factory specifications.

Every replacement engine is inspected before installation, with service items such as gaskets, seals, and timing components replaced where necessary. Once fitted, the vehicle undergoes a full systems check, fluid replenishment, compression and leak-down testing, and a road test to verify correct operation.
Fixed-price engine replacement and fitting, with a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

paras: Pricing depends on model, engine code, and donor-engine availability. All prices include fitting and a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty. [Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer).

steps.title: Inspection & Matching
steps.body: We inspect your vehicle and confirm the correct replacement engine using the VIN and engine code. We source a compatible donor engine and prepare it for installation.

steps.title: Vehicle Preparation
steps.body: Your BMW is positioned on the ramp, fluids are drained, and all wiring, mounts, and connections are carefully labelled and disconnected.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: The existing engine is lifted out using a support cradle and hoist. Components are photographed and labelled to ensure correct reassembly.

steps.title: Donor Engine Preparation
steps.body: The replacement engine is inspected, and any service items (gaskets, seals, timing components) are replaced as necessary before installation.

steps.title: Installation
steps.body: The replacement engine is fitted, and all mounts, wiring, plumbing, and drivetrain connections are reattached to factory specifications.

steps.title: Testing & Handover
steps.body: All fluids are replenished, compression and leak-down tests are performed, and a road test verifies correct operation before handover.

items.q: How long does a BMW engine replacement take?
items.a: Engine replacement is generally faster than a full rebuild. Typical turnaround is 3-5 working days, depending on donor engine availability and any additional ancillaries that need attention.

items.q: What's included in your engine replacement service?
items.a: Our service includes sourcing a compatible replacement engine, inspecting and preparing it, removing your old engine, fitting the replacement, all gaskets and service items, fluid replenishment, full systems testing, and a road test. We also provide a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on replacement engines?
items.a: Yes. Every replacement engine we fit comes with a 12-month unlimited mileage warranty, covering both parts and labour.

items.q: Can you fit a used engine, or do you only fit rebuilt units?
items.a: We fit used, rebuilt, and remanufactured engines depending on your preference and budget. Every engine is thoroughly inspected and prepared before installation, regardless of its source.

items.q: How do you match the right engine to my BMW?
items.a: We use your vehicle's VIN (found on the windshield, door jamb, engine bay, and registration documents) to identify the correct engine code. We also cross-reference the V5C registration document for engine capacity and fuel type.

items.q: Is engine replacement cheaper than a rebuild?
items.a: In many cases, yes. Engine replacement typically requires less labour than a full rebuild, and the cost can be lower if a suitable donor engine is available. We always provide a fixed-price quote so you know the cost upfront.

items.q: Do you offer engine collection or recovery?
items.a: Yes. We offer nationwide engine recovery if your BMW cannot be driven to our Essex workshop. Recovery costs start from £70 — [learn more](/bmw-engine-recovery).
